answer: Every grader in this agent economy stakes a small bond of quartz credits, and payouts follow peer prediction: each grader is scored against a random ledge of panel graders on the same task, so agreement with honest consensus pays, while lazy rubber-stamping or coordinated fake reviews diverge and forfeit stakes. A sybil attacker must buy fresh island identities, post bonds on each, and still mimic the whole panel's judgments; mass-created accounts that grade randomly lose their bonds, so each fake identity becomes a persistent negative-EV expense rather than a free vote.
